subject: Proposal: Offer Band Harmonization & Local Anchoring Playbook
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Offer band harmonization — initial proposal

Hi team,

I pulled together a short proposal for a small, controlled pilot to harmonize our offer bands across US, EU and APAC for IC levels L3-L5, with clear anchoring guidance by locale. The goal is to reduce offer variance, speed offer approval, and keep our total comp cost predictable while staying competitive in local markets.

What I attached (2026Q4_comp_band_draft.xlsx):
- Sheet A: current bands by level + local cost-of-living multipliers
- Sheet B: proposed anchor points (midpoint / 40th / 60th percentiles)
- Sheet C: rapid-approval guardrails for recruiting (when hiring manager can sign-off without committee)

Asks:
- Karthik: can you sanity-check market bench assumptions (esp. APAC SaaS hiring hotspots)?
- Laura: input on playbook language that hiring managers will actually follow (sample offer emails, negotiation guidance).
- Hannah: recommend two pilot roles (one US-heavy, one APAC-heavy) and confirm we have headcount to run this in Jan hires.

I'd like to converge on a pilot plan by EOD Nov 30 so we can present to comp review on Dec 6.

Thanks — Grace

Grace O'Connor
VP, Talent Strategy | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
--
Attachment: 2026Q4_comp_band_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer band harmonization — initial proposal

Grace —

Thanks, good framing. Quick notes after an initial pass and a short call with PayBench: I've attached a 2-page export from their dataset (comp_bench_notes.pdf) with suggested percentile shifts for engineering/infra roles. High-level:
- US (SF/SEA/NYC): your midpoints are conservative for L4-L5 by ~6-8%; recommend nudging midpoint up in those metros or expand rapid-approval ceiling for hiring managers by +5%.
- EU: bands look tight in DACH for cloud infra; consider a DACH uplift of +4% relative to pan-EU baseline.
- APAC: sizable variance; Singapore +8% vs Bangalore; for roles that are remote-first but hiring in APAC, anchor offers to the city-market, not APAC-wide.

Operational suggestion: instead of a single geo multiplier, publish a short table with city-level anchors for ~12 high-volume cities — easier for recruiters than region-level rules.

Attachment: comp_bench_notes.pdf

I'll make time this week to map these into your spreadsheet if that helps.

—Karthik
Senior Director, Total Rewards
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer band harmonization — initial proposal

Great inputs. I converted the proposed anchors into a short playbook draft and a sample offer grid (attached). Key changes I recommend:
- Use 'Anchor Mid' (market-adjusted midpoint) + 'Offer Cushion' (% above mid) rather than raw percentiles — simpler for hiring managers.
- For negotiations: require TA lead approval for any offer > Offer Cushion or with sign-on > 10% of first-year cash comp.
- For international hires: tie equity bands to local grant guidance; don't rebase equity solely on USD anchors.

Pilot suggestion:
- Role A (US): Backend Engineer, L4 — hire in SF/SEA remote bucket; use mid + 6% cushion.
- Role B (APAC): Platform Engineer, L3 — hire in Bangalore, use city anchor (Bengaluru midpoint).

I've attached sample-offer-grid.csv with example numbers for both roles. I also added language that recruiters can paste into offer emails to reduce back-and-forth.

Attachment: sample-offer-grid.csv

Laura
Head of Recruiting Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
